notes: The supplied *day* follows the article's own noun rather than standing in front of it, so rule 102 does not reach it: it is a generic completion on σάββασιν and the head stays on *sabbath* (rule 66). LUK.4.16 differs only because ἡμέρᾳ is expressed there.
τῆς before Γαλιλαίας is unrepresented under rule 23, matching LUK.4.44.
